products.description: The Kevin Levrone Anabolic Diuretic is a high-performance metabolic supplement from the “Black Line” series, specifically engineered for bodybuilders and athletes who need to eliminate subcutaneous water to achieve a “dry,” vascular, and rock-hard physique. Developed in collaboration with IFBB legend Kevin Levrone, this formula bridges the gap between traditional herbal remedies and professional-grade sports nutrition. Core Benefits and Functionality The primary goal of this supplement is fluid management . By flushing out excess water trapped between the skin and the muscle, it helps reveal the deep striations and muscle density that are often hidden by bloating. Muscle Hardness: Ideal for the final weeks of a contest prep or a photoshoot to ensure every muscle fiber is visible. Weight Management: Often used as a tool to make weight in sports with specific weight classes without sacrificing muscle mass. Electrolyte Support: Unlike harsh chemical diuretics, this formula includes botanical extracts that aim to manage fluid levels more naturally. Key Ingredient Breakdown The effectiveness of Anabolic Diuretic lies in its diverse, multi-phase botanical blend: Natural Diuretic Complex: Features Dandelion Root , Uva Ursi , and Stinging Nettle . These are powerhouse herbs known for increasing urine output and supporting kidney filtration to move stagnant water. Thermogenic Support: Includes Guarana Seed and Green Tea Leaf Extract . These provide a natural caffeine kick that boosts the metabolic rate, aiding in fat oxidation while simultaneously acting as mild diuretics. Inflammation & Recovery: White Willow Bark (a natural source of salicin) is included to help manage the minor systemic inflammation often associated with intense training and “drying out.” Bioavailability: The formula is rounded out with BioPerine® (Black Pepper Extract) , which significantly increases the absorption of the other herbal components, ensuring nothing goes to waste. Suggested Use & Strategy To get the most out of the 90-tablet bottle: Dosage: The standard serving is typically 3 tablets daily , preferably taken with a meal. The “Water Paradox”: It sounds counterintuitive, but you must drink more water (at least 3–4 liters a day) while taking this. If you stop drinking water, your body will fight to hold onto every drop it has, negating the supplement’s effects. Cycle Length: This is not a year-round supplement. It is best used in short bursts (typically 10–14 days) leading up to a specific event. Safety & Quality Standards As part of the Kevin Levrone Signature Series, this product is manufactured under strict quality controls. However, because it impacts hydration levels: Avoid taking it late in the evening due to the caffeine content. Discontinue use if you experience severe muscle cramps or dizziness. Always consult a professional if you have pre-existing kidney or heart conditions.

products.description: Bpi Cla+ Carnitine 50ser NON STIMULANT WEIGHT LOSS BPI Sports CLA + Carnitine is a tested and trusted non-stimulant weight loss supplement that not only helps boost performance, but also improves metabolism. Conjugated linoleic acid (CLA) and carnitine are two popular ingredients that have been clinically shown to help with weight management. CLA works by inhibiting lipoprotein lipase (LPL). LPL allows fat cells to extract fat from the bloodstream and store it. By curbing LPL, CLA effectively prevents fat storage, encouraging the body to burn it instead.* Carnitine supports weight loss due to its role as a fat transporter. Even when you’re burning a ton of calories each day, you won’t necessarily burn off fat. That’s because fat must first reach the mitochondria, the powerhouse of your body’s cells. The easiest way to ensure this happens is by supplementing with a fat transporter, like carnitine. Carnitine helps maximize the amount of freed-up fat cells you can burn away for good by transporting the fat cells directly into the mitochondria.

products.description: Bpi Cla+ Carnitine 50ser NON STIMULANT WEIGHT LOSS BPI Sports CLA + Carnitine is a tested and trusted non-stimulant weight loss supplement that not only helps boost performance, but also improves metabolism. Conjugated linoleic acid (CLA) and carnitine are two popular ingredients that have been clinically shown to help with weight management. CLA works by inhibiting lipoprotein lipase (LPL). LPL allows fat cells to extract fat from the bloodstream and store it. By curbing LPL, CLA effectively prevents fat storage, encouraging the body to burn it instead.* Carnitine supports weight loss due to its role as a fat transporter. Even when you’re burning a ton of calories each day, you won’t necessarily burn off fat. That’s because fat must first reach the mitochondria, the powerhouse of your body’s cells. The easiest way to ensure this happens is by supplementing with a fat transporter, like carnitine. Carnitine helps maximize the amount of freed-up fat cells you can burn away for good by transporting the fat cells directly into the mitochondria.

Out of the nine essential amino acids, the BCAAs (Leucine, Iso-leucine & Valine) play a crucial role in muscle protein synthesis and recovery.
